primary_workload: All The Small Things.mid, MuseScore General SF2, 44.1 kHz, default fourth-order interpolation, effects enabled, 64-frame write requests, 10-second render interval
primary_metric: candidate/base render_wall_s, paired by render with identical inputs/settings
ci: two-sided 95% Student-t interval on mean paired log ratio; exponentiate bounds
acceptance: combined 30-pair 95% CI upper bound < 0.98; both independent batches have candidate/base median < 1; all primary pair output hashes match; A/A control centered near 1
stop_rules: No sample-size expansion after seeing results; do not broaden to full matrix if primary gate fails or any guard workload has a repeatable slowdown over 3%
